description: Predict GAIA agent performance where the underlying model parameter scale is explicitly published.

contract.law_signature: law(input_data: list[dict[str, float]], group: str) -> list[dict[str, float]]

target_description: The response is the source-reported benchmark quantity identified by the `group` label; the law predicts one scalar metric within each group. Representative metric labels are score, score level1, score level2, score level3.
